data.name: AIM BOOTCAMP
data.detailed_description:
This is an AIM training simulator designed for FPS gamers.

Game Objective

Eliminate targets that appear at regular intervals with precise headshots and aim for high scores. Push your reaction speed and shooting accuracy to the limit, and compete with players from around the world.

Game Modes

Score Attack Mode: Keep eliminating targets that continue to appear until you run out of ammunition. HP indicates your remaining ammo, and the session ends when you're out of bullets. The challenge is how many targets you can accurately eliminate.

Time Attack Mode: Challenge yourself to eliminate a fixed number of targets as quickly as possible. Aim for the fastest clear time.

Mini-Game Mode: Enjoy a slot game between training sessions. Line up three matching symbols to earn in-game currency and exclusive weapon skins. Multiple guaranteed-win effects—such as cut-ins, fake consecutive wins, and more—heighten the excitement when you hit.

Key Features

Quantitative Performance Measurement: Measure your reaction speed and AIM accuracy numerically, allowing you to objectively track your skill improvement.

Online Ranking System: Your scores are compared with players worldwide and reflected on the global leaderboard.

Weapon Skin Unlocks: Unlock various weapon skins as you continue playing.

Simple Yet Refined Game Mechanics: No complicated rules. Aim and shoot. That's it. However, mastering it is challenging.

Recommended For

Players looking to improve their AIM accuracy in FPS games

Esports players aspiring to excel in competitive scenes

Those who want to compete in reaction speed and precision

Players seeking pure skill-based challenges

Note1: This game does not feature story or character progression elements. It is a training tool purely focused on honing your skills and competing for scores.

Note2: The slot mini-game can only be played with in-game currency. It does not involve real-money gambling, and nothing can be exchanged or redeemed for real-world money.
